title: 2D Game Engine
requirements: raylib or SDL3 via vcpkg/FetchContent; CMake *(on your own machine: Xenon has no graphics window, so build the engine's logic here and the rendering there)*
Your ECS from [[M11 Projects]], fixed-timestep loop from [[10.08 Time and Chrono]], arena allocators per frame
Systems: rendering (sprite batching), input, physics (AABB collisions, spatial hash grid), audio, animation
Asset loading on a worker thread with futures; hot-reload of a config/JSON file
Ship a small complete game (platformer, top-down shooter, or puzzle) with Tracy profiling markers
